description: GUI designer for the Tokotachi C++ GUI library
command.newWindow.title: New Window...
command.generateCode.title: Generate Code
command.openAsText.title: Open as Text
config.generateOnSave: Generate the C++ code when a window definition (`*.ttui.json`) is saved.
config.commentLocale: Language of the comments in the generated code.
config.namespace: Namespace of the generated classes (e.g. `app::ui`). Empty for none.
config.headerDir: Folder of the generated headers, relative to the window definition. Empty for the same folder.
config.sourceDir: Folder of the generated sources, relative to the window definition. Empty for the same folder.
config.colorScheme: Color scheme of the canvas. `auto` follows the color theme of VS Code.
